message.content:
You are building the My Quizzes page and Quiz Builder page for a Shopify app called QuizSnap. Write TWO files:

## File 1: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.tsx`

My Quizzes page - shows all quizzes with creation ability.

### Page Structure:
- Title: "My Quizzes"
- Primary action: "+ Create quiz" button that opens a modal
- Empty state when no quizzes (illustration + "Create your first quiz" CTA)

### Template Picker Modal
When "+ Create quiz" is clicked, show a Modal with 6 template cards in a 3x2 grid:

| Template | Category | Questions | Types |
|----------|----------|-----------|-------|
| Skincare Finder | Beauty, Wellness | 5 | Single choice, Image choice, Multiple select, Slider, Email capture |
| Supplement Advisor | Health, Fitness | 4 | Single choice, Yes/No, Multiple select, Email capture |
| Style Finder | Apparel, Fashion | 4 | Image choice, Single choice, Dropdown, Email capture |
| Hair Care Match | Hair, Beauty | 4 | Single choice, Dropdown, Slider, Email capture |
| Fitness Advisor | Sports, Health | 5 | Single choice, Multiple select, Slider, Yes/No, Email capture |
| Start from blank | Custom | 0 | Manual |

Skincare Finder gets a "Popular" badge, Supplement Advisor gets a "New" badge.

Each card shows: emoji icon, template name, category tags, question count.

### AI Generation Overlay
After selecting a template (not blank), show a full-screen overlay with:
- Spinning animation (use CSS)
- Progress steps checklist:
  1. Reading product catalogue...
  2. Generating questions & answers...
  3. Mapping products to answers...
  4. Finalising your quiz...
- After ~3 seconds, navigate to quiz builder

### Quiz List (when quizzes exist)
Same IndexTable as dashboard showing all quizzes with Edit/Preview/Archive actions.

Use mock data for 3 sample quizzes.

## File 2: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.$id.tsx`

Quiz Builder page - the main quiz editing interface.

### Page Structure:
- Title: "[Quiz Name]" with back button to /app/quizzes
- Save button (primary action)
- Preview button (secondary action)
- Status badge (Draft/Live)

### Use Polaris `Tabs` for 3 main sections:

#### Tab 1: Questions
- Left sidebar: list of questions (reorderable)
- Right panel: question editor
  - Question title (TextField)
  - Question type (Select: Single choice, Multiple choice, Image choice, Dropdown, Slider, Yes/No, Email capture)
  - Answer options list (each with label TextField + delete button)
  - "Add answer" button
  - "Add question" button at bottom of sidebar

#### Tab 2: Product Mapping
- For each answer option, show a product selector
- Uses a simple TextField + "Browse products" button pattern
- Show mapped products as tags/pills below each answer

#### Tab 3: Design
- Quiz title TextField
- Description TextField
- Button color picker (TextField with hex code)
- Button text TextField (default "Next")
- Results page heading TextField
- Show/hide progress bar toggle

### Mock Data:
Pre-populate with 3 questions if template-based:
1. "What's your skin type?" - Single choice (Oily, Dry, Combination, Normal)
2. "What's your main concern?" - Multiple select (Acne, Aging, Hydration, Sensitivity)
3. "How old are you?" - Dropdown (18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45+)

## Technical Requirements for BOTH files:
- Use loader with `authenticate.admin(request)` from `../shopify.server`
- Use `useNavigate` from react-router for navigation
- Use `useAppBridge` for toast notifications
- Import Polaris components from `@shopify/polaris`
- Use useState, useCallback for state management
- Export headers using `boundary.headers` from `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server`
- Use Polaris: Page, Layout, Card, Modal, TextField, Select, Button, Badge, IndexTable, Tabs, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Banner, ProgressBar, Checkbox, Tag, EmptyState, Spinner, Icon, Thumbnail, Divider, ButtonGroup
- Do NOT use s-* web components, ONLY Polaris React components

content.text: Good, I have the patterns. Now let me create both files.

Both files have been created. Here is a summary:

### File 1: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.tsx`
**My Quizzes page** with:
- Page title "My Quizzes" with a "+ Create quiz" primary action button
- **Empty state** with illustration and CTA (togglable via `showEmptyState` flag)
- **Quiz list** using IndexTable with 3 mock quizzes, showing quiz name/emoji, status badge, questions count, completions, conversion rate, revenue, updated date, and Edit/Preview/Archive action buttons
- **Template picker modal** with 6 template cards in a 3x2 CSS grid -- Skincare Finder (Popular badge), Supplement Advisor (New badge), Style Finder, Hair Care Match, Fitness Advisor, and Start from blank. Each card shows emoji, name, category tags, and question count
- **AI generation overlay** -- full-screen overlay with CSS spinning animation and 4 progress steps that animate sequentially over ~3 seconds, then navigates to the quiz builder with a toast notification
- Selecting "Start from blank" skips the AI overlay and navigates directly

### File 2: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.$id.tsx`
**Quiz Builder page** with:
- Page title showing quiz name, back button to `/app/quizzes`, Save primary action, Preview secondary action, and status Badge (Draft/Live)
- **Polaris Tabs** with 3 sections:
  - **Questions tab**: Left sidebar listing all questions (numbered, clickable, highlighted when selected) with an "Add question" button; right panel with question title TextField, question type Select (7 types), answer options list with label TextFields and delete buttons, and "Add answer" button
  - **Product Mapping tab**: For each question and answer option, a TextField + "Browse products" button pattern; mapped products shown as removable Tag components
  - **Design tab**: Quiz title, description (multiline), button color with hex input and color swatch preview, button text, results page heading, show/hide progress bar Checkbox; includes a live preview panel on the right showing how the quiz will look
- Pre-populated with 3 mock questions (skin type - single choice, main concern - multiple select, age - dropdown) for quiz ID "1", with product mappings included
